name: Kryotech Solutions
description: Innovating thermal management for peak performance.
story: Kryotech Solutions is a leading Thai company specializing in advanced cooling solutions for high-performance computing and electronics. Recognizing the extreme thermal demands of motorsport, they see an opportunity to showcase their technology's resilience and effectiveness in a demanding environment. Kryotech seeks a partnership to enhance brand awareness and demonstrate the real-world applications of their cooling technology.
